_meta.purpose: FAQ question library , use as a guide for which questions to include on each page. Not exhaustive. Mix and match per page; aim for 4-6 questions per page that cover definition, symptoms/diagnosis, treatment, prevention/when-to-see-doctor.
_meta.source: Curated from presentation-analysis.xlsx (37 topics × 10 questions = 370 source questions, narrowed to ~5 per topic). Plus one tenant-customizable bucket: 'clinic_specific'.
_meta.structure: Each top-level key is a sitemap slug or a special bucket. The page should pull from this when rendering its FAQ block.
_meta.writing_rule: Answer in 30-60 words, Grade 8 reading level, in the practice voice from content-style-guide.md. No em dashes, no emojis.
_meta.tenant_customization: The 'clinic_specific' topic is for site-wide FAQs unique to this practice (walk-in policy, parking, language support, after-hours, etc.). Empty by default. Each tenant fills in 4-8 questions that get rendered on /contact, /about, and the homepage FAQ section.

clinic_specific._note: Renders on /contact, /about, and the homepage FAQ section. Add 4-8 questions specific to this clinic's policies, amenities, and operations. Empty array below for the demo build. Replace with real questions when a tenant is assigned.
